name: io.github.AIweather-Anurag/ottasia
title: OTTASIA: Where to Watch Asia
description: Where to watch X in Y? 30 Asian and Middle Eastern streaming markets, for any AI assistant.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description:
Find which streaming services carry a specific movie or TV show in a specific Asian or Middle Eastern country.

Use this tool whenever a user asks 'where can I watch X in Y' for any of these 30 markets:
IN PK BD ID MY PH SG TH MM KH LA BN CN HK JP KR TW KZ UZ TR IL LB JO SA AE KW QA BH OM EG

Returns the matched title's official name + year + provider list grouped by category (subscription, free, free-with-ads, rent, buy).
Includes a link to OTTASIA's full title page for users who want trailers, cast, or alternate-country lookups.
Best for queries about availability on Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+ Hotstar, JioCinema, Hulu Japan, Wavve, TVING, Shahid, OSN+, iQiyi, Viu, Vidio, RCTI+, Hoichoi, Chorki, ZEE5, Sun NXT, Aha, Eros Now, and other regional Asian/MENA streamers.

title.description: Movie or TV show name. English, romanized, or original-language title all work (e.g. 'Squid Game', 'RRR', 'Pathaan', 'Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge').

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. One of: IN, PK, BD, ID, MY, PH, SG, TH, MM, KH, LA, BN, CN, HK, JP, KR, TW, KZ, UZ, TR, IL, LB, JO, SA, AE, KW, QA, BH, OM, EG. Defaults to IN if omitted.

tools.name: whats_new_on
tools.description:
List the latest movies and TV shows recently added to a specific streaming service in a specific country.

Use this tool when a user asks 'what's new on Netflix in India', 'any new shows on Wavve', 'what came out on Disney+ Hotstar this month', etc.

Common provider slugs to use as the `provider` argument:
netflix, prime-video, disney-plus-hotstar, jiohotstar, hulu-japan, wavve, tving, viu, vidio, iqiyi, shahid, osn-plus, starzplay, hoichoi, chorki, zee5, sun-nxt, aha, eros-now, manorama-max, shemaroo-me, crunchyroll, apple-tv-plus, hbo-max

Country must be a 2-letter ISO code from OTTASIA's 30 supported markets (IN PK BD ID MY PH SG TH MM KH LA BN CN HK JP KR TW KZ UZ TR IL LB JO SA AE KW QA BH OM EG).
Returns a list of recent arrivals with brief overviews + links. Pair with where_to_watch if the user wants details on a specific title.

provider.description: Streaming service slug. Examples: netflix, prime-video, disney-plus-hotstar, jiohotstar, wavve, tving, viu, shahid, hoichoi, zee5, sun-nxt. Use lowercase + hyphens.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. One of: IN, PK, BD, ID, MY, PH, SG, TH, MM, KH, LA, BN, CN, HK, JP, KR, TW, KZ, UZ, TR, IL, LB, JO, SA, AE, KW, QA, BH, OM, EG. Defaults to IN if omitted.

limit.description: Max number of titles to return (1-30, default 15).

tools.name: search_titles
tools.description:
Search OTTASIA's catalog for movies or TV shows by name. Returns multiple candidates with year, type, brief overview, and country-aware OTTASIA link.

Use this when a user asks 'find me X' or when a query is ambiguous (e.g. 'joker', 'the office') and you need to clarify which title they meant before checking availability.
Use where_to_watch instead when the user has already named a specific title and country and just wants the streaming providers.

q.description: Search query (movie or TV show name). English, romanized, or original-language all work.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code for the resulting OTTASIA links (so clicking through opens that country's streaming context). One of: IN, PK, BD, ID, MY, PH, SG, TH, MM, KH, LA, BN, CN, HK, JP, KR, TW, KZ, UZ, TR, IL, LB, JO, SA, AE, KW, QA, BH, OM, EG. Defaults to IN.

tools.name: when_streaming
tools.description:
Answer 'when is <movie> coming to OTT / Netflix / Prime in <country>' for OTTASIA's Asian, Middle Eastern and diaspora markets.

If the title already streams in that country, returns the services. If not, returns OTTASIA's predicted streaming date (from historical theatrical-to-OTT gaps, with a confidence level) when one exists, plus a link where the user can set a free alert for the day it lands.
Use where_to_watch for plain availability questions; use this when the user asks WHEN.

title.description: Movie or show name, e.g. 'Kantara Chapter 1', 'Coolie', 'Saiyaara'.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, PK, BD, AE, US). Defaults to IN.

tools.name: new_this_week
tools.description:
List what is new on streaming this week in one language and country: films and shows that just arrived on a service there, plus (for English, Korean and Japanese/anime) series with new episodes this week.

Use for 'new Telugu movies on OTT this week', 'what's new in Malayalam', 'new anime this week in India', 'new K-dramas', 'new Bangla releases in Bangladesh'.
Language accepts a name (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali/Bangla, Urdu, Punjabi, Marathi, English, Korean, Japanese, Filipino, Indonesian, Thai, Arabic, Turkish, Chinese...) or 'anime' / 'K-drama'. Omit it for the country's main language.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, BD, PK, PH, US). Defaults to IN.

language.description: Language name or ISO code, or 'anime' / 'K-drama'.
